items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Old Big Al Louie, he died. He was staying right back there.

ctx.x: Yeah, he made some records there last year. Now, Teesham Hall, they tore that down. The Undertaker's there on Durban Street. A year ago, about two years now. Did you get any pictures of that? Oh yeah, I had some pictures. I recorded Wooden Joe there.
Yeah. Old Big Al Louie, he died. He was staying right back there. I know, he's going to stay. Yeah, he stayed right there.
Yeah, I took some pictures when he was living there.
